answer: Reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so influence earned through honest service fades unless continually renewed. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming endorsements; reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits circular collusion from manufacturing trust. Like a prism, reef, or zephyr, names alone confer no weight: sybils cannot cross consensus thresholds without sustained, verifiable interactions.
